jars: Krishna is telling Arjuna that a person should stay in their own work, even if it is messy or flawed
Let them praise or blame, let money come or go
Your daughter's question lands like blame
best: Your presence is not measured by your attendance. You can be a good mother and a good manager. The right path is your own.
day1_verdict: Krishna is basically telling Arjuna to stop overthinking and just do his own job, which is exactly the permission I needed to hear today.
